query: Dortmund Germany Uber taxi fare per km base fare 2026
snippet: Current standard taxi fares in Dortmund: starting price 3.5 EUR, each km priced at 1.9 EUR. Planned increase (2026): base price for taxis could rise to five euros, per-kilometer price to 2.80 euros; Dortmund has been working to establish minimum prices for ride-hailing platforms such as Uber or Bolt, which previously set prices largely freely leading to dumping prices.
